verification.validation: Hyper Backup online export tolerates files the App removes, replaces or shortens during the walk and logs backup/control failures to syslog. appbackup Go tests (with a real sqlite3), go build and go vet on a Linux runner, sdk-version, executor manifest and documentation version checks, and an internal-content scan of the packed npm tarballs. npm packages packed from this commit. No full gate, target matrix, executor rebuild, Rust build, crate publication or NAS acceptance.

changes: Online application backup skips a file the App removes or renames while the export walks the data folder; a replaced file is archived as opened and a file shortened during the read is padded with zeros. Permission, I/O and SQLite errors still fail the export, and every export error names the path.
A failed backup/control export or import writes one syslog line tagged synopkgland-backup with the package, the path and the error.
